chronicConditions.name: Severe persistent asthma
chronicConditions.notes: Childhood-onset. 1 ICU admission (2018) for status asthmaticus. Triggers: dust, exertion, cold air. Two ED visits in past year for exacerbations.

chronicConditions.name: Pregnancy, intrauterine, 22 weeks gestation
chronicConditions.notes: G2P1. Estimated due date 2025-09-18. Singleton, confirmed by 20-week anatomy scan. No complications to date. Patient cleared by OB for Hajj travel with hydration/heat precautions.

medications.frequency: 2 puffs PRN for wheeze, max q4h

allergies.reaction: Severe bronchospasm within minutes (AERD/Samter's triad suspected)

surgeries.procedure: Low transverse cesarean section (failure to progress)
surgeries.notes: Healthy female infant 3.2 kg. No complications. Spinal anesthesia.

vaccinations.name: Tdap (administered during current pregnancy at 20 weeks)

clinicalNotes.author: Dr. Elif Karaca, OB/GYN — Acıbadem Maslak
clinicalNotes.content: Pre-Hajj pregnancy review at 22 weeks. Fetus appropriate for gestational age. Asthma stable on current regimen. Counseled patient: avoid crowded dusty areas where possible, carry rescue inhaler at all times, seek help immediately if rescue inhaler use exceeds q4h. Cleared for travel with caveats.

clinicalNotes.author: Dr. Burak Demir, Pulmonology
clinicalNotes.content: Asthma well-controlled in recent months. Recent peak flow 380 L/min (personal best 420). Reviewed action plan in Turkish — patient demonstrates correct inhaler technique. AERD strongly suspected — strict NSAID avoidance reinforced.

demoPresentingComplaint.ar: نوبة ربو متوسطة بسبب الغبار. استجابت جزئياً للبخاخ. حامل في الأسبوع 22.
demoPresentingComplaint.en: Moderate asthma attack from dust. Partial response to inhaler. 22 weeks pregnant.
